### FREQUENTLY   ASKED QUESTIONS:

#### [VIEW ALL FAQS >](https://trtnation.com/faqs/)

#### [Who qualifies for weight loss medications?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1672779131702-9f75dc10-f756)

Eligibility is determined by a healthcare provider and isn’t guaranteed. Typically, candidates include Adults 25+ with a BMI over 25.

#### [What makes medical weight loss different from dieting on my own?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1775831959561-67b78d29-36c0)

Diet and exercise alone work for some people, but for many, hormonal resistance, metabolic dysfunction, and hunger signaling make sustainable weight loss extremely difficult. Medical weight loss uses prescribed and clinically proven medications to work with your biology — not against it — so you can finally see results that last.

#### [What is tirzepatide and how does it work?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1775832029021-e690f52f-19e0)

Tirzepatide is a dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist, meaning it activates two separate hormonal pathways that regulate blood sugar, appetite, and fat storage. It slows gastric emptying, reduces appetite dramatically, and helps your body use energy more efficiently. Clinical trials have shown average weight loss of 15–20%+ of total body weight. It is one of the most effective weight loss medications ever developed.

#### [How is tirzepatide different from semaglutide (Ozempic/Wegovy)?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1766006195776-a9a0f5a8-f6af)

Both are in the GLP-1 class, but tirzepatide activates an additional receptor (GIP) that semaglutide does not. This dual-action mechanism has shown superior weight loss results in head-to-head clinical comparisons. Many patients who plateaued on semaglutide have found renewed progress with tirzepatide.

#### [What is phentermine and who is it best for?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1672840367888-d0042a51-cb6d)

Phentermine is an appetite suppressant that has been used safely for decades. It works by stimulating the central nervous system to reduce hunger. It is best suited for patients who need strong short-to-medium term appetite control and want a more affordable, proven option. TRT Nation providers will assess your health history to confirm it’s right for you.

#### [How much weight can I expect to lose?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1672840548785-2a98a754-2415)

Results vary by individual, but patients on tirzepatide in clinical studies lost an average of 15–22% of their body weight over approximately 72 weeks. Phentermine patients typically see meaningful results in the first 12 weeks. Your provider will set realistic, personalized expectations based on your starting point and goals. [Source](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35658024/)

#### [Are there side effects I should know about?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1672840551047-5f096be1-9c98)

Tirzepatide’s most common side effects are nausea, mild GI discomfort, and decreased appetite — most of which improve as your body adjusts. At TRT Nation, we compound every tirzepatide prescription with vitamin B12 to make treatment more tolerable and effective. B12 not only helps reduce nausea but also supports energy, metabolism, red blood cell health, and nervous system function—giving you an added boost on your weight loss journey.

Phentermine can cause increased heart rate or mild nervousness in some patients. TRT Nation providers start patients at conservative doses and titrate slowly to minimize side effects.

#### [Do I have to follow a strict diet while on these medications?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1766006203366-55de0829-483a)

No strict diet is required, but our providers offer nutritional guidance to help you maximize your results. The medications significantly reduce appetite naturally, making it much easier to make better food choices without feeling deprived.

#### [Does the cost go up if my dose increases?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1672840688125-45f1e5e8-4452)

At TRT Nation, we prioritize transparency and accessibility so you can focus on your health, not unexpected price increases. That’s why we offer tirzepatide at a consistent rate of $219 per month, regardless of dosage.

Unlike some clinics that advertise low introductory pricing only to increase costs as treatment progresses, our pricing remains straightforward and predictable. Our goal is for there to be clarity during the weight loss journey that allows our patients to commit to their health journey without financial surprises along the way.

#### [How do I get started with a weight loss program at TRT Nation?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1672841209659-ab371453-3ace)

Simply complete our online intake form, consult with a provider, and if appropriate, your prescription is sent to your door. No in-person visits required.

#### [Will I gain the weight back when I stop?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1766006204164-6cdab1ab-8b9b)

Weight regain is possible if lifestyle habits aren’t addressed. That’s why TRT Nation combines medication with provider guidance on sustainable habits. Many patients use these medications as a “reset” that helps them establish new, lasting patterns around food and activity.

#### [Where does my medication come from?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1766006206279-3737a865-4129)

Medications are prescribed by licensed healthcare providers and dispensed through regulated U.S. pharmacies following a medical screening and provider consultation.

#### [How is the medication shipped?](https://trtnation.com/weight-loss-therapy/\#1766006205035-b9037a33-4b1d)

All medications are shipped via FedEx. Patients must download the FedEx mobile app to track packages.
